steps: Create a free Branded Surveys account and complete your profile.
Take surveys; points credit per survey (total shown at top of dashboard).
When you reach 500 approved points, redeem for $5 PayPal (or gift card / US bank transfer).
Receive the money in about 1-3 business days.
timing: 500 points = $5 PayPal; deposits in about 1-3 business days after redemption (US bank transfer: 24-48h after 1-2 day approval).
who_pays: Branded Surveys pays you when you redeem points — 500 approved points = $5, paid via PayPal, gift card, or US bank transfer.
who_qualifies: A free account; you need a PayPal account for cash payouts (bank transfer is US only) and may need a valid phone number to verify identity at cashout.
work_available: Survey availability and per-survey points vary — you take whatever surveys are posted to your dashboard; screen-outs pay little.
what_gets_accepted: Completed surveys credit points that must be approved before they count toward redemption. If you screen out of a survey, you earn only a small number of points.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join, no fees. Unpaid time: building your profile and time spent on surveys you screen out of (small points only), plus waiting for points to be approved before redeeming.
when_cash_arrives: Once you redeem 500+ points, PayPal deposits in about 1–3 business days (US bank transfer: approved in 1–2 business days, posts within 24–48 hours).
